properties.name: Dharampur Cloudburst
properties.history: August 2015: Intense cloudburst led to sudden flooding in Dharampur town. The bus stand was completely submerged, and several buses were washed away. Significant damage to property and local infrastructure.
properties.remarks: Highlighted the vulnerability of towns built near mountain streams.

properties.name: Manikaran Cloudburst
properties.history: July 6, 2022: Cloudburst in Chojh village near Manikaran. Several people were washed away as the Parvati river swelled suddenly. Multiple camping sites and bridges were destroyed.
properties.remarks: Affected the busy tourism circuit of Parvati Valley.

properties.name: Samej Massive Cloudburst
properties.history: August 1, 2024: One of the worst cloudbursts in HP. Wiped out whole hamlets in Samej, Rampur. Over 30 people missing. Massive debris flow downstream.
properties.remarks: Caused catastrophic damage to both life and energy infrastructure (Malana II project).

properties.name: Thathri Cloudburst
properties.history: August 1, 2024: Occurred simultaneously with Samej. High intensity rain caused small streams to turn into raging torrents of mud and boulders.

properties.name: Bagipul Cloudburst
properties.history: July 31, 2024: Sudden heavy rain in Nirmand area. Bagipul market saw massive debris inflow. Houses and shops were washed away.
properties.remarks: Critical road connectivity to Anni and Nirmand cut off.

properties.name: Jahalman Cloudburst
properties.history: July 2021: Cloudburst in Jahalman nallah in Lahaul valley. Caused blockage of Chandrabhaga river and damage to agriculture land.
properties.remarks: Rare high-intensity event in cold desert region.
